Dear Hiring Manager,
I'm applying for the Management and Program Analyst position, GS-0343-11, in your office. I've spent
the last five years managing performance data and grant reporting for a county human services
department, and before that I ran grants for a nonprofit food program.
Much of what your announcement describes is work I do now. I track performance for 14 programs,
built the department's monthly dashboard in Power BI and prepare quarterly reports for four federal and
state grants worth $11 million. Those grants have been through two federal monitoring reviews with no
findings.
I also like the part of the job that changes how programs run. Last year I led a review of our emergency
rental program's application process. By removing two duplicate steps and changing how documents
were requested, we cut the average decision time from 34 days to 19.
Thank you for considering my application. My resume follows the format in the announcement, and I'd
be glad to provide anything else you need.
Sincerely,
Jerome Whitley
